size.value: 35-40mm wide x 45-50mm high (a range, not fixed dimensions)

background.value: Plain white or light grey background that contrasts with face

head_height.value: 32-36mm from chin to crown of head

validity.value: Photo must be less than 6 months old

file_spec.value: Printed: clear, unedited, high-gloss heavy-weight paper, colour gloss prints. Digital specifications not detailed on main page

expression_restriction.value: Neutral expression - not smiling, laughing or frowning

glasses_policy.value: No glasses allowed in passport photos since 1 July 2018. Medical exception only where glasses cannot be removed for medical reasons

ears_visibility.value: Hair off face so edges of face are visible

face_visibility.value: Face looking directly at camera, not tilted in any direction. Face centered, edges of face clearly visible. For children over 3: eyes open and facing camera straight on

is_white_background_allowed.value: Yes - plain white is one of the two officially allowed backgrounds (white or light grey)
